body:
### Describe the bug

When using the `gh` CLI, when hitting the `/repos/$ORG/$REPO/dependabot/alerts` endpoint, a 403 error is accompanied by the message "gh: This API operation needs the "delete_repo" scope."

### Affected version

```
gh version 2.103.3 (2026-10-26)
https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.103.3
```

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Create a repo
2. Do not enable dependabot alerts for it and/or have a token that doesn't no have permissions to read the alerts
3. List them via the CLI

### Expected vs actual behavior

Expected: The error message says what scopes are actually needed.

Actual: The error messages tells me I need to be able to delete my repo in order to read security alerts.

### Logs

```
GH_DEBUG=api gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10' --paginate --jq '.[]' '/repos/$ORG/$REPO/dependabot/alerts?state=open&per_page=100'
* Request to https://api.github.com/repos/$ORG/$REPO/dependabot/alerts?state=open&per_page=100
> GET /repos/$ORG/$REPO/dependabot/alerts?state=open&per_page=100 HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.github.com
> Accept: application/vnd.github+json
> Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
> User-Agent: GitHub CLI 2.103.3
> X-Github-Api-Version: 2026-03-10

< HTTP/2.0 403 Forbidden
< Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
< Server: github.com
< X-Accepted-Oauth-Scopes: admin:repo_hook, delete_repo, read:repo_hook, repo, repo:invite, repo:status, repo_deployment, security_events, write:repo_hook
< X-Github-Api-Version-Selected: 2026-03-10
< X-Github-Media-Type: github.v3; format=json
< X-Oauth-Scopes: admin:public_key, admin:repo_hook, gist, read:org, repo

{
  "message": "Dependabot alerts are disabled for this repository.",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/dependabot/alerts#list-dependabot-alerts-for-a-repository",
  "status": "403"
}

* Request took 523.382517ms
{
  "message": "Dependabot alerts are disabled for this repository.",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/dependabot/alerts#list-dependabot-alerts-for-a-repository",

gh: Dependabot alerts are disabled for this repository. (HTTP 403)
gh: This API operation needs the "delete_repo" scope. To request it, run:  gh auth refresh -h github.com -s delete_repo
```
title: CLI reports `delete_repo` scope needed on 403 for /dependabot/alerts endpoint
